title: Leica Cyclone workflows and connector status
description: Explore Leica Cyclone workflow ideas in Vector OS. Connector status: Upcoming. Development and release dates have not been announced.

Leica Cyclone

Leica Cyclone supports laser-scan registration, point-cloud processing and reality-capture deliverables. These intended workflows refer to Cyclone REGISTER 360 PLUS.

On the software discovery list. Connector development and release dates have not been announced.

Workflow ideas

Register field scans

Begin with the selected field-scan Setups or Bundles and coordinate basis. In the intended Leica Cyclone REGISTER 360 PLUS preview, register field scans; the visible result is a proposed registered point cloud with alignment and registration quality available for review. Review overlap, survey control where applicable, coordinate basis and registration error before accepting or exporting it.

Classify point-cloud data

Use the imported point-cloud Setups or Bundles and an applicable classification model or manual class assignment. In the intended Leica Cyclone REGISTER 360 PLUS preview, classify point-cloud data; the visible result is a point cloud with proposed classes and class visibility. Review class assignments and retained points; automatic classification remains subject to its separate package and hardware requirements.

Publish coordinated reality context

Start from the reviewed finalized registration. In the intended Leica Cyclone REGISTER 360 PLUS preview, publish coordinated reality context; the visible result is a proposed point-cloud deliverable or registration report from that finalized registration. Review coordinate basis, units, completeness and the selected eligible output target before publishing or exporting; format, server and licensing requirements remain applicable.

Source and compatibility

Cyclone REGISTER 360 PLUS capability context — manual primary-source review

Manual review of vendor text exposed by the web tool on 2026-10-06 is recorded in product-claim-sources.json. Historical failed raw retrieval remains preserved; no HTTP success or vendor-body hash is inferred. Capability context does not prove Vector OS implementation, native execution or engineering acceptance.
